title: The Pre-Order for White Industries’ Desert Sage Line Ends Friday
content:
White Industries Desert Sage collection features a curated selection of its most popular products, finished in a light tan colored cerakote. These parts look even better covered in dust and are a great excuse to match your frame’s finish! The Pre-Order ends on September 18th, so act quickly! Roll on over to White Industries to pre-order the Desert Sage Collection!

The post The Pre-Order for White Industries’ Desert Sage Line Ends Friday appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
